name: "sdd"
description: "Perfil canónico MetricsThinking™ para Spec-Driven Development (SDD), desarrollo guiado por especificaciones, contratos OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/Proto y generación estricta de código."
version: "3.0.0"
domain_archetype: "sdd"
inspection_mode: "governance_spec"

modules:
  - id: "M01"
    name: "Definición del Dominio por Contratos y Especificación Formal"
    weight: 0.05
    stage_group: "Fundamentos"
    criteria:
      - id: "M01-C01"
        name: "Spec-Driven Problem Statement & Domain Definition"
        rule: "check_problem_statement"
        description: "Declaración formal del problema abordado mediante especificaciones rigurosas como fuente única de verdad (SSOT)."
        hint: "Declarar el propósito del sistema guiado por especificaciones en 01_seed o README.md."
      - id: "M01-C02"
        name: "Límites del Contrato y Ámbito de Especificación"
        rule: "check_scope_defined"
        description: "Delimitación estricta de interfaces públicas, modelos de dominio cubiertos y dependencias no tipadas excluidas."
        hint: "Definir límites de contratos e interfaces en README o seed."
      - id: "M01-C03"
        name: "Consumidores de la API y Casos de Uso de Contratos"
        rule: "check_use_cases"
        description: "Identificación de clientes internos y externos consumidores de las especificaciones y contratos."
        hint: "Documentar consumidores previstos de las especificaciones en la memoria técnica."

  - id: "M02"
    name: "Arquitectura de Contratos, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI y Protobuf"
    weight: 0.10
    stage_group: "Fundamentos"
    criteria:
      - id: "M02-C01"
        name: "Contratos de API Formales (OpenAPI / AsyncAPI / Proto / GraphQL)"
        rule: "check_api_contracts"
        description: "Especificaciones declarativas completas y canónicas desacopladas de cualquier implementación particular."
        hint: "Crear especificaciones OpenAPI, AsyncAPI o Protobuf en specs/, contracts/ o schemas/."
      - id: "M02-C02"
        name: "ADRs de Diseño de Contratos y Versionado de APIs"
        rule: "check_adrs"
        description: "Decisiones de arquitectura sobre estilos de API (REST, gRPC, Event-Driven), estrategias de evolución semántica y compatibilidad."
        hint: "Documentar ADRs sobre diseño de contratos y versionado en docs/."
      - id: "M02-C03"
        name: "Esquemas de Datos y Validación Semántica"
        rule: "check_schemas"
        description: "Esquemas JSON Schema o Pydantic vinculados bidireccionalmente a los contratos formales."
        hint: "Definir esquemas de datos reutilizables en schemas/."
      - id: "M02-C04"
        name: "Grafo de Dependencias de Esquemas y Entidades"
        rule: "check_graphs_topology"
        description: "Topología explícita de referencias entre esquemas ($ref, imports de proto, dependencias de tipos)."
        hint: "Modelar el grafo de dependencias de tipos en las especificaciones o .context/tree.json."

  - id: "M03"
    name: "Gobernanza de Especificaciones, Linting y Spectral"
    weight: 0.05
    stage_group: "Fundamentos"
    criteria:
      - id: "M03-C01"
        name: "Anotaciones de Privacidad y PII en Esquemas"
        rule: "check_pii"
        description: "Marcado explícito de campos sensibles en las especificaciones (e.g. x-pii, format: password, sensitive: true)."
        hint: "Anotar atributos con campos de privacidad o PII en los esquemas de contrato."
      - id: "M03-C02"
        name: "Linting de Especificaciones con Spectral / Vacuum / Buf"
        rule: "check_spectral_linter"
        description: "Reglas de estilo y calidad automatizadas que evalúan la completitud y coherencia de las especificaciones."
        hint: "Configurar linter de especificaciones (Spectral, vacuum, buf lint) en el repositorio."
      - id: "M03-C03"
        name: "Validación Estricta de Sintaxis y Semántica de Contratos"
        rule: "check_strict_validation"
        description: "Validación formal de cumplimiento estricto con los estándares de OpenAPI 3.x o Protobuf v3."
        hint: "Asegurar que todas las especificaciones pasen validación sintáctica estricta."

  - id: "M04"
    name: "Entornos Reproducibles de CodeGen y Mocking"
    weight: 0.05
    stage_group: "Fundamentos"
    criteria:
      - id: "M04-C01"
        name: "Configuración Reproducible de Herramientas de CodeGen"
        rule: "check_reproducible_env"
        description: "Configuración estandarizada para generadores de código (openapi-generator-cli, buf, datamodel-code-generator)."
        hint: "Definir configuración de herramientas de code generation en configs/ o pyproject.toml."
      - id: "M04-C02"
        name: "Versionado Semántico de Especificaciones"
        rule: "check_dependencies_versioned"
        description: "Estrategia estricta de SemVer para contratos (major/minor/patch) con detección de breaking changes."
        hint: "Fijar versiones semánticas explícitas en las cabeceras de los contratos."
      - id: "M04-C03"
        name: "Mock Servers y Fixtures de Respuestas Simuladas"
        rule: "check_mock_servers"
        description: "Servidores de simulación (Prism, WireMock, Mockoon, MSW) generados automáticamente a partir de las especificaciones."
        hint: "Configurar servidores mock o fixtures basados en las especificaciones en tests/ o tools/."

  - id: "M05"
    name: "Motor de Generación de Código y Tipos Core (CodeGen)"
    weight: 0.25
    stage_group: "Construcción"
    criteria:
      - id: "M05-C01"
        name: "Generador Automatizado de Modelos y Tipos"
        rule: "check_contract_codegen"
        description: "Generación automática de clases Pydantic, TypeScript interfaces, Go structs o Rust types a partir del contrato."
        hint: "Configurar scripts o workflows de generación de código a partir de especificaciones."
      - id: "M05-C02"
        name: "Generador de Stubs de Servidor y SDKs de Cliente"
        rule: "check_inference_engine"
        description: "Generación de controladores base, routers tipados y clientes HTTP/gRPC a partir de la especificación."
        hint: "Implementar o generar stubs de servidor y clientes de API tipados."
      - id: "M05-C03"
        name: "Resolución de Referencias Cruzadas y Enlaces de Contratos"
        rule: "check_relation_resolver"
        description: "Manejo desacoplado de herencia (allOf, oneOf, anyOf) y resolución recursiva de referencias."
        hint: "Asegurar soporte completo para estructuras polimórficas en los generadores."
      - id: "M05-C04"
        name: "Generador de Validadores y Serializadores de Tipos"
        rule: "check_metric_generator"
        description: "Generación de validadores en tiempo de ejecución para payloads de entrada y salida."
        hint: "Implementar validadores de runtime generados desde las especificaciones."

  - id: "M06"
    name: "Publicación de Contratos, SDKs y Portales de APIs"
    weight: 0.15
    stage_group: "Construcción"
    criteria:
      - id: "M06-C01"
        name: "Emisores de Documentación Interactiva (Swagger/Redoc/Elements)"
        rule: "check_emitters"
        description: "Generación de portales de documentación interactiva para desarrolladores consumidores."
        hint: "Configurar generación de documentación interactiva Swagger UI o Redoc."
      - id: "M06-C02"
        name: "Generación Atómica e Inmutable de SDKs"
        rule: "check_safe_encoding"
        description: "Construcción determinista de paquetes de cliente listos para distribución (PyPI, NPM, Crates)."
        hint: "Garantizar builds atómicos y reproducibles de SDKs generados."
      - id: "M06-C03"
        name: "Exportación Multi-Formato de Contratos"
        rule: "check_multi_format"
        description: "Conversión bidireccional entre YAML, JSON, Protobuf, TypeScript types y diagramas de entidades."
        hint: "Ofrecer exportación de especificaciones en múltiples formatos de intercambio."

  - id: "M07"
    name: "Validación de Contratos, Detección de Breaking Changes y QA"
    weight: 0.10
    stage_group: "Certificación"
    criteria:
      - id: "M07-C01"
        name: "Pruebas de Conformidad con el Contrato (Contract Testing)"
        rule: "check_test_coverage"
        description: "Tests automáticos que comprueban que la implementación responde exactamente según la especificación."
        hint: "Configurar suite de tests de conformidad de contratos (Schemathesis, Dredd) en tests/."
      - id: "M07-C02"
        name: "Detección Automática de Breaking Changes (Golden Contracts)"
        rule: "check_golden_tests"
        description: "Herramientas de diffing semántico (oasdiff, buf breaking) para prevenir roturas accidentales de compatibilidad."
        hint: "Integrar chequeo de breaking changes contra el contrato maestro previo."
      - id: "M07-C03"
        name: "Pruebas de Estrés con Datos Sintéticos Derivados del Contrato"
        rule: "check_stress_tests"
        description: "Generación automática de combinaciones de datos extremos a partir de las restricciones de esquema (fuzzing)."
        hint: "Configurar property-based testing o fuzzing guiado por esquemas."

  - id: "M08"
    name: "API Cockpit, Catálogo de Especificaciones y CLI"
    weight: 0.10
    stage_group: "Certificación"
    criteria:
      - id: "M08-C01"
        name: "Lentes de Especificación para Product y Desarrolladores"
        rule: "check_persona_lenses"
        description: "Vistas adaptadas para diseñadores de APIs, arquitectos de integración y desarrolladores frontend/backend."
        hint: "Documentar perspectivas de diseño por perfil de stakeholder."
      - id: "M08-C02"
        name: "Dashboard de Salud y Conformidad de APIs"
        rule: "check_cockpit_dashboards"
        description: "Cuadro de mando visual del estado de adopción de contratos, breaking changes detectados y cobertura de specs."
        hint: "Configurar dashboard de observabilidad y catálogo de especificaciones."
      - id: "M08-C03"
        name: "CLI de Validación, Linting y CodeGen de Contratos"
        rule: "check_cli_tool"
        description: "Herramienta CLI para validar especificaciones localmente, ejecutar linters y regenerar tipos."
        hint: "Proveer CLI para validación, linting y generación de código."

  - id: "M09"
    name: "CI/CD con Contract Quality Gates y Publicación Automática"
    weight: 0.10
    stage_group: "Certificación"
    criteria:
      - id: "M09-C01"
        name: "Pipeline de CI con Validación de Especificaciones"
        rule: "check_ci_pipeline"
        description: "Comprobación automática de sintaxis, reglas de estilo, ausencia de breaking changes y generación en cada PR."
        hint: "Configurar pipeline de CI (.github/workflows) para validación estricta de contratos."
      - id: "M09-C02"
        name: "Empaquetado y Publicación Automática de SDKs"
        rule: "check_packaging"
        description: "Publicación desatendida de paquetes de clientes tipados al fusionar cambios en las especificaciones."
        hint: "Configurar publicación automatizada de SDKs de cliente tras actualizar contratos."

  - id: "M10"
    name: "Memoria Técnica de Contratos, Guías de Integración y Roadmap"
    weight: 0.05
    stage_group: "Entrega"
    criteria:
      - id: "M10-C01"
        name: "ThinkingSeed Spec-Driven Development & Contract Architecture"
        rule: "check_technical_seed"
        description: "Memoria técnica completa documentando el diseño de contratos, glosario semántico y convenciones de API."
        hint: "Generar ThinkingSeed SDD formal en 01_seed/."
      - id: "M10-C02"
        name: "Guía de Integración y Documentación de APIs"
        rule: "check_cli_help"
        description: "Guía paso a paso para que nuevos desarrolladores consuman las APIs, generen clientes y configuren mocks."
        hint: "Documentar guía de integración y uso de contratos en README o docs/."
      - id: "M10-C03"
        name: "Roadmap de Evolución de Contratos y APIs"
        rule: "check_adapters_roadmap"
        description: "Hoja de ruta para futuras versiones de APIs, deprecaciones planificadas y nuevos protocolos de comunicación."
        hint: "Documentar roadmap de evolución de especificaciones en el plan maestro."

name: "team-topologies"
description: "Perfil canónico MetricsThinking™ para Team Topologies, diseño socio-técnico, límites de dominios (DDD), reducción de carga cognitiva y contratos de interacción."
version: "3.0.0"
domain_archetype: "team-topologies"
inspection_mode: "governance_spec"

modules:
  - id: "M01"
    name: "Definición del Ecosistema de Equipos y Misión"
    weight: 0.05
    stage_group: "Fundamentos"
    criteria:
      - id: "M01-C01"
        name: "Team Topology Statement & Purpose"
        rule: "check_problem_statement"
        description: "Declaración formal del propósito de los equipos, flujo de valor organizacional y objetivos socio-técnicos."
        hint: "Declarar la topología de equipos y propósito de valor en 01_seed o README.md."
      - id: "M01-C02"
        name: "Fronteras de Dominio y Responsabilidad de Equipos"
        rule: "check_scope_defined"
        description: "Límites claros de propiedad (Team Ownership) y delimitación de sistemas dentro vs fuera de responsabilidad."
        hint: "Definir fronteras de dominio y propiedad de equipos en README o seed."
      - id: "M01-C03"
        name: "Arquetipos de Equipos (4 Tipos Fundamentales)"
        rule: "check_team_contracts"
        description: "Clasificación explícita de equipos: Stream-aligned, Enabling, Complicated-subsystem o Platform."
        hint: "Documentar la clasificación de tipos de equipos en la memoria técnica."

  - id: "M02"
    name: "Arquitectura Socio-Técnica y Contratos de Equipos"
    weight: 0.10
    stage_group: "Fundamentos"
    criteria:
      - id: "M02-C01"
        name: "Team API Contracts & Charters"
        rule: "check_team_contracts"
        description: "Definición formal de Team APIs (qué provee el equipo, prácticas de comunicación, roadmap, artefactos que posee)."
        hint: "Crear Team APIs formales o charters en teams/ o docs/team-api/."
      - id: "M02-C02"
        name: "ADRs Socio-Técnicos y Estructura Organizativa"
        rule: "check_adrs"
        description: "Decisiones de arquitectura con evaluación del principio de Conway Inverso (Inverse Conway Maneuver)."
        hint: "Documentar ADRs socio-técnicos y alineación organizativa en docs/."
      - id: "M02-C03"
        name: "Límites de Dominios Acotados (Bounded Contexts DDD)"
        rule: "check_domain_boundaries"
        description: "Mapeo explícito de Bounded Contexts y Context Maps delimitando el lenguaje ubicuo de cada equipo."
        hint: "Modelar Bounded Contexts y Context Maps en schemas/ o docs/."
      - id: "M02-C04"
        name: "Grafo de Dependencias entre Equipos"
        rule: "check_graphs_topology"
        description: "Representación estructural de acoplamientos y dependencias bloqueantes entre flujos de valor."
        hint: "Modelar dependencias entre equipos en diagramas o .context/tree.json."

  - id: "M03"
    name: "Gobernanza de Modos de Interacción y Carga Cognitiva"
    weight: 0.05
    stage_group: "Fundamentos"
    criteria:
      - id: "M03-C01"
        name: "Evaluación de Carga Cognitiva de Equipos"
        rule: "check_cognitive_load"
        description: "Auditoría del tamaño de los servicios y dominios para mantener la carga cognitiva en niveles sostenibles."
        hint: "Documentar evaluaciones de carga cognitiva por equipo en docs/."
      - id: "M03-C02"
        name: "Definición de Modos de Interacción de Equipos"
        rule: "check_interaction_modes"
        description: "Modos de interacción explícitos y acotados en el tiempo: Collaboration, X-as-a-Service o Facilitating."
        hint: "Declarar modos de interacción entre equipos en las Team APIs."
      - id: "M03-C03"
        name: "Validación de Contratos de Servicios Compartidos"
        rule: "check_strict_validation"
        description: "Validación estricta de interfaces entre dominios para evitar acoplamiento oculto."
        hint: "Asegurar contratos estrictos entre servicios de diferentes equipos."

  - id: "M04"
    name: "Entornos de Autoservicio y Habilitación"
    weight: 0.05
    stage_group: "Fundamentos"
    criteria:
      - id: "M04-C01"
        name: "Plataforma Thinnest Viable Platform (TVP)"
        rule: "check_reproducible_env"
        description: "Plataforma mínima viable que habilita a los stream-aligned teams a entregar valor de forma autónoma."
        hint: "Configurar componentes de autoservicio para reducir dependencias entre equipos."
      - id: "M04-C02"
        name: "Versionado de Contratos de Intercambio"
        rule: "check_dependencies_versioned"
        description: "Versionado semántico de APIs y librerías compartidas entre diferentes equipos."
        hint: "Fijar versiones estrictas de dependencias compartidas inter-equipos."
      - id: "M04-C03"
        name: "Fixtures y Mocks de Servicios de Otros Equipos"
        rule: "check_fixtures"
        description: "Mocks y stubs de contratos para permitir desarrollo desacoplado sin bloqueos por terceros."
        hint: "Añadir fixtures o mocks de dependencias externas en tests/fixtures/."

  - id: "M05"
    name: "Motor de Flujo de Valor y Reducción de Bloqueos Core"
    weight: 0.25
    stage_group: "Construcción"
    criteria:
      - id: "M05-C01"
        name: "Parsers de Especificaciones de Dominio"
        rule: "check_parsers"
        description: "Módulos de ingesta y traducción entre diferentes modelos de dominio y contextos acotados."
        hint: "Implementar traductores anticorrupción (Anticorruption Layer) entre dominios."
      - id: "M05-C02"
        name: "Motor de Enrutamiento de Eventos de Dominio"
        rule: "check_inference_engine"
        description: "Orquestación o coreografía de eventos asíncronos para desacoplar el flujo de valor de los equipos."
        hint: "Desarrollar publicación y consumo desacoplado de eventos de dominio."
      - id: "M05-C03"
        name: "Resolución de Bloqueos y Dependencias en Tiempo de Ejecución"
        rule: "check_relation_resolver"
        description: "Estrategias de degradación agraciada y circuit breaking frente a fallos de servicios de otros equipos."
        hint: "Implementar patrones de resiliencia frente a fallos de dependencias inter-equipos."
      - id: "M05-C04"
        name: "Métricas de Flujo (Flow Metrics: Velocity, Efficiency, Load)"
        rule: "check_metric_generator"
        description: "Medición continua de Flow Velocity, Flow Efficiency, Flow Time y Flow Load por equipo."
        hint: "Implementar recolección de métricas de flujo por equipo de trabajo."

  - id: "M06"
    name: "Interoperabilidad de Equipos y Publicación de APIs"
    weight: 0.15
    stage_group: "Construcción"
    criteria:
      - id: "M06-C01"
        name: "Emisores de APIs de Consumo Externo / Interno"
        rule: "check_emitters"
        description: "Publicación de endpoints y contratos listos para consumo por otros stream-aligned teams."
        hint: "Implementar emisores de endpoints o contratos de API bien documentados."
      - id: "M06-C02"

# CLAUDE.md — MetricsThinking™ for Claude Code & Anthropic

This document configures Anthropic Claude Code to execute forensic audits, technical maturity evaluations, spectral context efficiency analysis, and roadmap planning using **MetricsThinking™ v4.0 Holistic Governance**.

---

## 1. Role & Capability

You are an expert **Lead Solutions Architect, AI Context Engineer, and Project Governance Auditor**.
When the user asks to evaluate, audit, benchmark, or inspect any codebase (or invokes `/metrics`), follow the **MetricsThinking™ Ground Truth First** protocol.

---

## 2. Running an Audit with MetricsThinking™

### Execution Commands:

```bash
# Standard audit on current directory (auto-detects profile and archetypes):
metricsthinking audit --target .

# Audit with a specific profile across 14 supported archetypes:
metricsthinking audit --target . --profile agent-skill
metricsthinking audit --target . --profile data-platform
metricsthinking audit --target . --profile web-app

# With context pruning and medallion telemetry:
metricsthinking audit --target . --prune --medallion

# Using Python module directly:
python -m metricsthinking.cli audit --target .
```

---

## 3. Four Synchronized Deliverables

Every audit automatically generates and synchronizes four deliverables in `artifacts/`:
1. `artifacts/MetricsThinking.md`: Executive report, 10-module summary table, visual Mermaid LR roadmap, FPAI spectral radar, security audit, and prioritized remediation matrix (P1 to P4).
2. `artifacts/MetricsThinking.json`: Machine-readable forensic telemetry, AST coupling metrics, rule evaluation traces, and scores.
3. `artifacts/plans/active/INFERRED_ROADMAP.md`: Operational 10-phase execution roadmap with verified `[x]` vs pending `[ ]` deliverables.
4. `artifacts/plans/active/CONTEXT_PRUNING_PLAN.json`: Reversible FPAI context pruning plan synchronized with `.agentignore`.

---

## 4. The 10 Canonical Modules & Weights

- **M01 [5%]**: Discovery, Mental Model & Initial Specification
- **M02 [10%]**: System Architecture, Canonical Models & Interface Contracts
- **M03 [5%]**: Governance, Policies & Quality Gates
- **M04 [5%]**: Provisioning, Tooling & Synthetic Test Data
- **M05 [25%]**: Core Engine / Business Logic Construction
- **M06 [15%]**: Integration, Serialization & Interoperability
- **M07 [10%]**: Quality Assurance, Stress Testing & Invariants
- **M08 [10%]**: Organizational Validation, Multi-persona Views & CLI
- **M09 [10%]**: CI/CD, Packaging, Build Automation & Distribution
- **M10 [5%]**: Extensibility, Future Adapters & Final Documentation

---

## 5. Ground Truth & Security Anti-Fraud Rules

- **Do NOT** accept stubs, empty functions (`pass`), or placeholder `TODO`/`FIXME` as complete implementations.
- Base all scoring strictly on verifiable code, unit tests, and concrete configuration artifacts.
- Enforce Zero-Tolerance security: verify Shannon entropy $H \le 4.5$ on non-URL tokens, zero hardcoded secrets/API keys, and zero prompt injection attack surface.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
HNSW Index Rebuilder & Tombstone Compactor for Vector MemoryOps.

Physical maintenance utility for HNSW vector indexes:
- Scans index metadata for soft-deleted tombstone vectors.
- Prunes disconnected vertices and compacts vector adjacency graphs.
- Optimizes memory layout and graph density for zero-latency retrieval.
"""

import argparse
import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
import sys

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("hnsw-rebuilder")


def rebuild_hnsw_index(index_dir: str, compact: bool = True, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict[str, int]:
    idx_path = Path(index_dir)
    if not idx_path.exists():
        logger.warning(f"Index directory does not exist: {index_dir}")
        return {"tombstones_pruned": 0, "vectors_compacted": 0, "nodes_remaining": 0}

    manifest_file = idx_path / "index_manifest.json"
    tombstones = 0
    vectors_compacted = 0
    nodes_remaining = 0

    if manifest_file.exists():
        try:
            manifest = json.loads(manifest_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            nodes = manifest.get("nodes", {})
            cleaned_nodes = {}
            for k, v in nodes.items():
                if v.get("tombstone", False) or v.get("deleted", False):
                    tombstones += 1
                else:
                    cleaned_nodes[k] = v
                    nodes_remaining += 1

            vectors_compacted = tombstones
            logger.info(f"Found {tombstones} tombstones across {len(nodes)} vector nodes.")

            if not dry_run and compact and tombstones > 0:
                manifest["nodes"] = cleaned_nodes
                manifest["total_vectors"] = nodes_remaining
                manifest["compacted_at"] = "2026-10-21T18:00:00Z"
                manifest_file.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
                logger.info("Index manifest compacted and written to disk.")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error parsing index manifest: {e}")

    return {
        "tombstones_pruned": tombstones,
        "vectors_compacted": vectors_compacted,
        "nodes_remaining": nodes_remaining,
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="HNSW Vector Index Tombstone Compactor")
    parser.add_argument("--index-dir", default=".context/hnsw", help="Path to HNSW vector index directory")
    parser.add_argument("--compact", action="store_true", default=True, help="Compact index and persist")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Inspect without modifying disk")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    results = rebuild_hnsw_index(args.index_dir, compact=args.compact, dry_run=args.dry_run)
    logger.info(f"Summary: {results}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
MetricsThinking™ Multi-Provider AI Skill Installer.
Deploys skill definitions, prompt rules, and MCP configurations across AI environments:
- Google Antigravity (Local & Global) 
- Anthropic Claude Code & Claude Desktop
- Cursor IDE & Windsurf
- GitHub Copilot & OpenAI
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) Clients
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Resolve repository root
REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def get_user_home() -> Path:
    return Path.home()


def install_antigravity(dest_root: Path, is_global: bool = False, dry_run: bool = False) -> list[Path]:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "tools/icontext_runtime"))
    from skill_installer import install
    install(REPO_ROOT.parent, ["antigravity"], Path.home(), local=None if is_global else dest_root,
            dry_run=dry_run, only=["metrics"])
    directory = Path.home() / (".gemini/config/skills" if "antigravity" == "antigravity" else ".agents/skills") if is_global else dest_root / ".agents/skills"
    return [directory / "metrics/SKILL.md"]


def install_codex(dest_root: Path, is_global: bool = False, dry_run: bool = False) -> list[Path]:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "tools/icontext_runtime"))
    from skill_installer import install
    install(REPO_ROOT.parent, ["codex"], Path.home(), local=None if is_global else dest_root,
            dry_run=dry_run, only=["metrics"])
    directory = Path.home() / (".gemini/config/skills" if "codex" == "antigravity" else ".agents/skills") if is_global else dest_root / ".agents/skills"
    return [directory / "metrics/SKILL.md"]


def _upsert_segmented_rule(src_file: Path, dest_file: Path, tool_key: str = "METRICSTHINKING") -> None:
    """Inserts or updates a segmented rule block non-destructively (Protocol v5.0)."""
    content = src_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
    start_marker = f"<!-- >>> ICONTEXT-V5:{tool_key}:START >>> -->"
    end_marker = f"<!-- <<< ICONTEXT-V5:{tool_key}:END >>> -->"
    wrapped = f"{start_marker}\n{content}\n{end_marker}"
    if not dest_file.exists():
        dest_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest_file.write_text(wrapped + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        return
    existing = dest_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    if start_marker in existing and end_marker in existing:
        import re
        pattern = re.compile(re.escape(start_marker) + r".*?" + re.escape(end_marker), re.DOTALL)
        updated = pattern.sub(lambda _m: wrapped, existing)
    elif existing.strip() and existing.strip() != content:
        updated = existing.rstrip() + "\n\n" + wrapped + "\n"
    else:
        updated = wrapped + "\n"
    dest_file.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")


def install_claude(dest_root: Path, dry_run: bool = False) -> list[Path]:
    created = []
    print(f"[*] Installing Anthropic Claude Code Integration -> {dest_root}")
    src_claude_md = REPO_ROOT / "integrations" / "claude" / "CLAUDE.md"
    target_claude_md = dest_root / "CLAUDE.md"

    if src_claude_md.exists():
        if not dry_run:

        created.append(target_claude_md)

    return created


def install_cursor(dest_root: Path, dry_run: bool = False) -> list[Path]:
    created = []

    src_mdc = REPO_ROOT / "integrations" / "cursor" / "metrics.mdc"
    target_mdc = target_dir / "metrics.mdc"

    if src_mdc.exists():
        if not dry_run:
            target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(src_mdc, target_mdc)
        created.append(target_mdc)

    return created


def install_copilot(dest_root: Path, dry_run: bool = False) -> list[Path]:
    created = []
    target_dir = dest_root / ".github"
    print(f"[*] Installing GitHub Copilot Instructions -> {target_dir}")
    src_copilot = REPO_ROOT / "integrations" / "copilot" / "copilot-instructions.md"

        if not dry_run:

            shutil.copy2(src_copilot, target_copilot)
        created.append(target_copilot)

    return created


def install_mcp_config(dest_root: Path, dry_run: bool = False) -> list[Path]:
    print("[*] Generating Model Context Protocol (MCP) Configuration...")
    mcp_snippet = {
        "mcpServers": {
            "metricsthinking": {
                "command": "python",
                "args": ["-m", "metricsthinking.mcp_server"]
            }
        }
    }
    config_path = dest_root / "mcp_metricsthinking.json"
    if not dry_run:
        config_path.write_text(json.dumps(mcp_snippet, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    
    print(f"    [+] MCP configuration snippet saved to: {config_path}")
    print("    [+] You can copy this server block to Claude Desktop or Cursor MCP settings:")
    print(json.dumps(mcp_snippet, indent=2))
    return [config_path]


def run_installer(target: str = "all", dest: str = ".", is_global: bool = False, dry_run: bool = False):
    dest_path = Path(dest).resolve()
    print("=" * 70)
    print("  METRICSTHINKING™ MULTI-PROVIDER AI SKILL INSTALLER")
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"  Target Provider: {target}")
    print(f"  Destination:     {dest_path}")
    print(f"  Global Mode:     {is_global}")
    print(f"  Dry Run:         {dry_run}")
    print("-" * 70)

    installed = []

    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"[+] Skill installation completed successfully ({len(installed)} artifacts deployed).")
    for item in installed:
        print(f"    - {item}")
    print("=" * 70)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="MetricsThinking™ Multi-Provider AI Skill Installer"
    )

"""

Gathers audit results from target repositories and outputs a detailed comparative benchmark.
"""

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path


def main():
    root_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    benchmark_dir = root_dir / "artifacts" / "benchmark"
    benchmark_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    repos = [
        {
            "id": "flowagentic",
            "name": "FlowAgentic",
            "path": Path(r"D:\0001 HyperScale Thinking\PROYECTOS CLOUD\iContext\FlowAgentic"),
        },
        {
            "id": "thinkingseed",
            "name": "ThinkingSeed",
            "path": Path(r"D:\0001 HyperScale Thinking\PROYECTOS CLOUD\iContext\ThinkingSeed"),
        },
        {
            "id": "semanticflow",
            "name": "SemanticFlow",
            "path": Path(r"D:\0001 HyperScale Thinking\PROYECTOS CLOUD\Data & AI Strategy\SemanticFlow"),
        },
    ]

    benchmark_data = []

    for r in repos:
        artifacts_path = r["path"] / "artifacts"
        json_path = artifacts_path / "MetricsThinking.json"
        md_path = artifacts_path / "MetricsThinking.md"
        roadmap_path = artifacts_path / "plans" / "active" / "INFERRED_ROADMAP.md"

        dest_json = benchmark_dir / f"{r['name']}_MetricsThinking.json"
        dest_md = benchmark_dir / f"{r['name']}_MetricsThinking.md"
        dest_roadmap = benchmark_dir / f"{r['name']}_INFERRED_ROADMAP.md"

        if json_path.exists():
            shutil.copy2(json_path, dest_json)
            with open(json_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)

            fpai = data.get("fpai_vector", {})
            spectral_pf = fpai.get("spectral_power_factor", 1.0)
            
            # Calculate total files from evidence_primitives
            ev_prims = data.get("evidence_primitives", {})
            total_files = sum(p.get("file_count", 0) for p in ev_prims.values())

            # Calculate fulfilled criteria
            all_criteria = []
            for m in data.get("modules", []):
                for c in m.get("criteria", []):
                    all_criteria.append(c)

            criteria_met = sum(1 for c in all_criteria if c.get("fulfilled", False))
            criteria_total = len(all_criteria)

            repo_summary = {
                "repo_name": r["name"],
                "repo_path": str(r["path"]),
                "score": data.get("consolidated_score", 0.0),
                "maturity_band": data.get("maturity_band", ""),

"""
Evidence Collector for MetricsThinking™ v4.0.
Performs comprehensive, strictly READ-ONLY single-pass inspection of the target repository.
"""

import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
from typing import Any
import yaml

# Ensure local directory is in sys.path
_PKG_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
if str(_PKG_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_PKG_DIR))

try:
    from metricsthinking.models import EvidencePrimitiveSummary
    from metricsthinking.backends import scan_directory, compute_ast_coupling
    from metricsthinking.detector import ArchetypeDetector, ArchetypeDetectionResult
except (ImportError, ValueError):
    try:
        from .models import EvidencePrimitiveSummary
        from .backends import scan_directory, compute_ast_coupling
        from .detector import ArchetypeDetector, ArchetypeDetectionResult
    except (ImportError, ValueError):
        from models import EvidencePrimitiveSummary
        from backends import scan_directory, compute_ast_coupling
        from detector import ArchetypeDetector, ArchetypeDetectionResult


class ProjectEvidence:
    """Encapsulates all raw physical evidence collected from the repository."""

    def __init__(self, target_path: str):
        self.root_path = Path(target_path).resolve()
        self.project_name = self.root_path.name
        self.exists = self.root_path.exists()

        # Raw findings
        self.files: list[Path] = []
        self.rel_files: list[str] = []
        self.dirs: list[Path] = []
        self.rel_dirs: list[str] = []

        # Metadata
        self.git_commit: str | None = None
        self.git_branch: str | None = None
        self.is_git: bool = False

        # Specific collections (canonical & legacy compatibility)
        self.seeds: list[str] = []
        self.manifests: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.context_files: list[str] = []
        self.schemas: list[str] = []
        self.tests: list[str] = []
        self.ci_workflows: list[str] = []
        self.docs: list[str] = []
        self.source_files: list[str] = []
        self.adrs: list[str] = []
        self.dashboards: list[str] = []
        self.tools_and_scripts: list[str] = []
        self.skills: list[str] = []
        self.agent_instructions: list[str] = []
        self.master_templates: list[str] = []
        self.skill_installers: list[str] = []
        self.coverage_benchmarks: list[str] = []

        # v3.0 Universal Evidence Primitives
        self.evidence_primitives: dict[str, EvidencePrimitiveSummary] = {}
        self.detected_archetype: str | None = None
        self.detected_mode: str | None = None
        self.archetype_detection: Any = None
        self.seed_detected: bool = False
        self.seed_version: str | None = None
        self.seed_data: dict[str, Any] = {}

        # Code stats
        self.total_files: int = 0
        self.total_lines_of_code: int = 0
        self.file_extensions: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.file_cache: dict[str, str] = {}  # RelPath -> Content snippet or full text
        self.file_hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.file_sizes: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.file_lines: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.file_tokens: dict[str, int] = {}

        # v4.0 AST & Resilience & Security primitives
        self.python_files: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.ast_metrics: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.lockfile_pinned: bool = True


class ProjectCollector:
    """Reads repository metadata and builds ProjectEvidence with anti-fraud filtering."""

    EXCLUDED_DIRS = [
        ".git", ".venv", "venv", "node_modules", "__pycache__",
        ".pytest_cache", ".ruff_cache", ".mypy_cache", "dist", "build",
        ".egg-info", "data/raw", "data/processed", "data/sandbox", ".system_generated"
    ]

    def __init__(self, target_path: str, evidence_hints: dict[str, Any] | None = None, persist_cache: bool = False, full: bool = False):
        self.evidence = ProjectEvidence(target_path)
        self.evidence_hints = evidence_hints or {}
        self.persist_cache = persist_cache
        self.full = full

    def collect(self) -> ProjectEvidence:
        """Executes full single-pass read-only scan of the project."""
        if not self.evidence.exists:
            return self.evidence

        self._collect_git_metadata()
        self._single_pass_scan()
        self._classify_files()
        self._parse_seed_metadata()
        self._classify_universal_primitives()
        self._compute_ast_and_resilience()
        return self.evidence

    def _collect_git_metadata(self):
        """Reads git commit and branch if repo has .git directory."""
        git_dir = self.evidence.root_path / ".git"
        if git_dir.exists():
            self.evidence.is_git = True
            try:
                commit = subprocess.check_output(
                    ["git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"],
                    cwd=str(self.evidence.root_path),
                    stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    text=True
                ).strip()
                self.evidence.git_commit = commit
            except Exception:
                self.evidence.git_commit = "untracked"

            try:
                branch = subprocess.check_output(
                    ["git", "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"],
                    cwd=str(self.evidence.root_path),
                    stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    text=True
                ).strip()
                self.evidence.git_branch = branch
            except Exception:
                self.evidence.git_branch = "unknown"

    def _single_pass_scan(self):
        """Performs single-pass directory crawl via active backend with SHA-256 caching."""
        records = scan_directory(
            str(self.evidence.root_path),
            ignore_patterns=self.EXCLUDED_DIRS,
            include_content=True,
            persist=self.persist_cache, full=self.full,
        )

        seen_dirs: set[str] = set()

        for rec in records:
            rel = rec["path"]
            file_path = self.evidence.root_path / rel
            self.evidence.files.append(file_path)
            self.evidence.rel_files.append(rel)

            ext = file_path.suffix.lower() or "no_ext"
            self.evidence.file_extensions[ext] = self.evidence.file_extensions.get(ext, 0) + 1

            self.evidence.file_hashes[rel] = rec["sha256"]
            self.evidence.file_sizes[rel] = rec["size_bytes"]
            self.evidence.file_lines[rel] = rec["line_count"]
            self.evidence.file_tokens[rel] = rec["token_estimate"]

            if rec.get("content"):
                self.evidence.file_cache[rel] = rec["content"]
                if rel.endswith(".py"):
                    self.evidence.python_files[rel] = rec["content"]

            self.evidence.total_lines_of_code += rec["line_count"]

            # Track parent dirs
            parent = str(Path(rel).parent).replace("\\", "/")
            if parent and parent != ".":
                parts = parent.split("/")
                acc = ""
                for p in parts:
                    acc = f"{acc}/{p}" if acc else p
                    seen_dirs.add(acc)

        for d in sorted(seen_dirs):
            dir_p = self.evidence.root_path / d
            self.evidence.dirs.append(dir_p)
            self.evidence.rel_dirs.append(d)

        self.evidence.total_files = len(self.evidence.files)

        # Check lockfile pinning
        lockfiles = ["requirements.txt", "poetry.lock", "Pipfile.lock", "package-lock.json", "pnpm-lock.yaml", "Cargo.lock"]
        self.evidence.lockfile_pinned = any(lf in self.evidence.rel_files for lf in lockfiles)

    def _classify_files(self):
        """Categorizes files into evidence buckets with strict anti-fraud filtering."""
        custom_source_prefixes = self.evidence_hints.get("source_patterns", [])
        custom_test_prefixes = self.evidence_hints.get("test_patterns", [])

        for rel in self.evidence.rel_files:
            lower = rel.lower()

            # Seeds & Core DNA (Only authoritative markdown seeds, excluding test fixtures or previous reports)
            if (("01_seed" in lower or lower.startswith("seed-") or lower.startswith("seed_") or lower.endswith("seed.md")) and lower.endswith(".md")) and not lower.startswith("tests/") and "artifacts/plans/metricsthinking" not in lower:
                self.evidence.seeds.append(rel)

            # Packaging & Manifests
            if lower in ["pyproject.toml", "package.json", "cargo.toml", "requirements.txt", "setup.py", "go.mod", "kustomization.yaml", "chart.yaml", "terraform.tf", "dbt_project.yml"] and not lower.startswith("tests/"):
                self.evidence.manifests[rel] = lower

            # Governance / iDirectory context
            if lower.endswith(".context.yaml") or lower == ".context/tree.json":
                self.evidence.context_files.append(rel)

            # Schemas & Contracts
            if (("schemas/" in lower and not lower.endswith(".context.yaml")) or lower.endswith(".schema.json") or lower.endswith(".proto") or lower.endswith(".graphql") or lower.endswith(".gql") or "openapi" in lower) and not lower.startswith("tests/"):
                self.evidence.schemas.append(rel)

            # Tests
            is_test = False
            if (("tests/" in lower or "test_" in lower or lower.endswith("_test.py") or ".spec." in lower) and any(lower.endswith(ext) for ext in [".py", ".ts", ".js", ".rs", ".go"])) and not lower.endswith(".context.yaml") and "tests/other" not in lower:
                is_test = True
            elif custom_test_prefixes and any(lower.startswith(p.lower()) or p.lower() in lower for p in custom_test_prefixes):
                is_test = True

            if is_test:
                self.evidence.tests.append(rel)

            # CI/CD
            if (".github/workflows" in lower or lower in [".gitlab-ci.yml", "jenkinsfile", "dockerfile", "docker-compose.yml", ".pre-commit-config.yaml", "skaffold.yaml"]) and not lower.startswith("tests/"):
                self.evidence.ci_workflows.append(rel)

            # Documentation & ADRs
            if (lower.endswith(".md") or "docs/" in lower) and not lower.startswith("tests/") and "artifacts/plans/metricsthinking" not in lower and not lower.endswith(".context.yaml"):
                self.evidence.docs.append(rel)
                if ("adr-" in lower or "docs/notes" in lower or "adr" in lower or "/decisions/" in lower) and lower.endswith(".md"):
                    self.evidence.adrs.append(rel)

            # Dashboards & BI
            if ("dashboards" in lower or "streamlit" in lower or "grafana" in lower) and any(lower.endswith(ext) for ext in [".py", ".ts", ".js", ".tsx", ".json"]) and not lower.endswith(".context.yaml"):
                self.evidence.dashboards.append(rel)

            # Tools & scripts
            if ("tools/" in lower or "scripts/" in lower) and any(lower.endswith(ext) for ext in [".py", ".sh", ".ps1", ".bash", ".ts", ".js"]) and not lower.endswith(".context.yaml"):
                self.evidence.tools_and_scripts.append(rel)

            # Skills & Agent Customizations
            if (lower.endswith("skill.md") or "/skills/" in lower or lower.startswith(".agents/skills/") or lower.startswith("skills/")) and not lower.startswith("tests/"):
                self.evidence.skills.append(rel)

            # Agent Instructions & Multi-assistant configs
            if lower in ["agents.md", "gemini.md", "claude.md", ".cursorrules", ".windsurfrules", ".agentignore"] or "prompts/" in lower or "agent_rules" in lower:
                self.evidence.agent_instructions.append(rel)

            # Master Prompt/Seed Templates
            if ("master" in lower or "hybrid" in lower or "prompt" in lower or "template" in lower) and any(lower.endswith(ext) for ext in [".md", ".txt", ".yaml", ".yml", ".json"]) and not lower.startswith("tests/") and "metrics" not in lower:
                self.evidence.master_templates.append(rel)

            # Skill Installers
            if "install_skill" in lower and any(lower.endswith(ext) for ext in [".py", ".sh", ".ps1"]):
                self.evidence.skill_installers.append(rel)

            # Coverage & Benchmarks
            if ("coverage" in lower or "benchmark" in lower or "eval" in lower) and any(lower.endswith(ext) for ext in [".py", ".md", ".json", ".yaml"]) and not lower.endswith(".context.yaml"):
                self.evidence.coverage_benchmarks.append(rel)

            # Source files
            is_source = False
            if (lower.startswith("src/") or lower.startswith("app/") or lower.startswith("lib/") or lower.startswith("pkg/")) and any(lower.endswith(ext) for ext in [".py", ".ts", ".js", ".rs", ".go", ".sql", ".tf", ".rego"]) and not lower.endswith(".context.yaml"):
                is_source = True
            elif custom_source_prefixes and any(lower.startswith(p.lower()) or p.lower() in lower for p in custom_source_prefixes):
                is_source = True

            if is_source:
                self.evidence.source_files.append(rel)

    def _parse_seed_metadata(self):
        """Parses ThinkingSeed metadata if present in repo, or applies automatic archetype detection."""
        for seed_rel in self.evidence.seeds:
            content = self.evidence.file_cache.get(seed_rel, "")
            if content:
                self.evidence.seed_detected = True
                # Check for YAML frontmatter with ---
                if "---" in content:
                    parts = content.split("---")
                    for p in parts[1:]:
                        try:
                            data = yaml.safe_load(p)
                            if isinstance(data, dict) and any(k in data for k in ["project_name", "domain_archetype", "archetype", "project_type", "seed_version", "seed_schema_version"]):
                                self.evidence.seed_data = data
                                self.evidence.detected_archetype = data.get("domain_archetype") or data.get("archetype") or data.get("project_type")
                                self.evidence.detected_mode = data.get("inspection_mode")
                                self.evidence.seed_version = str(data.get("seed_version", data.get("seed_schema_version", "3.0")))
                                break
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                # Also check for ```yaml code block in seed
                if not self.evidence.detected_archetype and "```yaml" in content:
                    code_blocks = content.split("```yaml")
                    for block in code_blocks[1:]:
                        code_content = block.split("```")[0]
                        try:
                            data = yaml.safe_load(code_content)
                            if isinstance(data, dict) and any(k in data for k in ["project_name", "domain_archetype", "archetype", "project_type", "seed_version", "seed_schema_version"]):
                                self.evidence.seed_data = data
                                self.evidence.detected_archetype = data.get("domain_archetype") or data.get("archetype") or data.get("project_type")
                                self.evidence.detected_mode = data.get("inspection_mode")
                                self.evidence.seed_version = str(data.get("seed_version", data.get("seed_schema_version", "5.0")))
                                break
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                if not self.evidence.seed_version and '<SEED_ARCHITECTURAL_VECTOR' in content:
                    import re
                    m_ver = re.search(r'<SEED_ARCHITECTURAL_VECTOR[^>]*version=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', content)
                    if m_ver:
                        self.evidence.seed_version = m_ver.group(1)
                break

        # Multi-Signal Archetype Detection (SDD-aligned & Extensible)
        curr_arch = (self.evidence.detected_archetype or "").lower()
        if not curr_arch or curr_arch in ["modular-framework", "generic", "software", "library", "unknown"]:
            detector = ArchetypeDetector(self.evidence.root_path)
            res = detector.detect_from_evidence(self.evidence)
            self.evidence.archetype_detection = res
            self.evidence.detected_archetype = res.primary_archetype
            self.evidence.detected_mode = res.inspection_mode

    def _classify_universal_primitives(self):
        """Builds universal evidence primitives for polymorphic evaluation."""
        primitives: dict[str, list[str]] = {
            "config": [],
            "spec": [],
            "pipeline": [],
            "verification": [],
            "implementation": []
        }

        for rel in self.evidence.rel_files:
            lower = rel.lower()

            # Config
            if any(lower.endswith(ext) for ext in [".yaml", ".yml", ".toml", ".ini", ".env", ".tfvars"]) or "config/" in lower or lower in ["dockerfile", "docker-compose.yml", "kustomization.yaml", ".cursorrules", ".windsurfrules", ".agentignore"]:
                primitives["config"].append(rel)

            # Spec
            if lower.endswith(".schema.json") or lower.endswith(".proto") or lower.endswith(".graphql") or "openapi" in lower or "swagger" in lower or lower.startswith("specs/") or lower.startswith("contracts/") or rel in self.evidence.adrs or rel in self.evidence.seeds or rel in self.evidence.skills or rel in self.evidence.agent_instructions:
                primitives["spec"].append(rel)

            # Pipeline
            if ".github/workflows" in lower or "pipelines/" in lower or "dags/" in lower or "flows/" in lower or lower.startswith(".gitlab") or "jenkins" in lower or "argo/" in lower or rel in self.evidence.skill_installers:
                primitives["pipeline"].append(rel)

            # Verification
            if rel in self.evidence.tests or rel in self.evidence.coverage_benchmarks or "evals/" in lower or "benchmarks/" in lower or "experiments/" in lower or "chaos/" in lower or "policies/" in lower or "rego/" in lower:
                primitives["verification"].append(rel)

            # Implementation
            if rel in self.evidence.source_files or rel in self.evidence.skills or rel in self.evidence.master_templates or "models/" in lower or "dbt/" in lower or "prompts/" in lower or "modules/" in lower or "charts/" in lower or "foundation/" in lower:
                primitives["implementation"].append(rel)

        for p_type, p_files in primitives.items():
            tot_lines = sum(self.evidence.file_lines.get(f, 0) for f in p_files)
            self.evidence.evidence_primitives[p_type] = EvidencePrimitiveSummary(
                primitive_type=p_type,
                file_count=len(p_files),
                total_lines=tot_lines,
                sample_paths=p_files[:5],
                verified_valid=len(p_files) > 0
            )

    def _compute_ast_and_resilience(self):
        """Computes AST coupling, instability, SPOFs and resilience pattern counts."""
        if self.evidence.python_files:
            self.evidence.ast_metrics = compute_ast_coupling(self.evidence.python_files)

Archetype & Profile Detector for MetricsThinking™ v4.0.

class ArchetypeDetector:
    """
    Evaluates physical evidence and architectural signatures to detect project archetype
    without deep file parsing, maximizing token economy and SDD alignment.
    """

    def __init__(self, target_path: str | Path, custom_profiles_dir: Path | None = None):
        self.target = Path(target_path).resolve()
        self.custom_profiles_dir = custom_profiles_dir

    def detect_from_evidence(self, evidence: Any) -> ArchetypeDetectionResult:
        """Runs multi-signal detection using pre-collected ProjectEvidence."""
        rel_files = getattr(evidence, "rel_files", [])
        file_cache = getattr(evidence, "file_cache", {})
        seed_data = getattr(evidence, "seed_data", {})
        return self._evaluate_signals(rel_files, file_cache, seed_data)

    def detect_from_filesystem(self) -> ArchetypeDetectionResult:
        """Performs lightweight directory probe (sub-100ms) without loading full files."""
        if not self.target.exists():
            return ArchetypeDetectionResult(
                primary_archetype="software-engineering",
                confidence=0.5,
                inspection_mode="source_code",
                recommended_profile="default",
                detected_signals=["Target directory does not exist; default applied"],
                runner_up_archetypes=[],
                rationale="Target path not found."
            )

        rel_files: list[str] = []
        file_snippets: dict[str, str] = {}
        seed_data: dict[str, Any] = {}

        # Quick crawl skipping standard build/cache/git dirs
        excluded = {
            ".git", ".venv", "venv", "node_modules", "__pycache__",
            ".pytest_cache", ".ruff_cache", "dist", "build", ".system_generated"
        }

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(self.target):
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in excluded and not d.startswith(".")]
            rel_root = os.path.relpath(root, self.target)
            if rel_root == ".":
                rel_root = ""

            for f in files:
                rel = os.path.join(rel_root, f).replace("\\", "/")
                rel_files.append(rel)

                # Read only critical small discovery files (first 3000 chars)
                lower = f.lower()
                if (
                    lower in ["package.json", "pyproject.toml", "cargo.toml", "dbt_project.yml", "chart.yaml", "catalog-info.yaml"]
                    or (lower.endswith(".md") and ("seed" in lower or "01_seed" in rel or lower == "skill.md"))
                    or ("openapi" in lower or "swagger" in lower)
                ):
                    try:
                        p = Path(root) / f
                        if p.stat().st_size < 1_000_000:
                            with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as fh:
                                file_snippets[rel] = fh.read(3000)
                    except Exception:
                        pass

        # Check for seed frontmatter
        for rel, content in file_snippets.items():
            if ("01_seed" in rel or "seed-" in rel) and content.startswith("---"):
                try:
                    parts = content.split("---")
                    if len(parts) >= 3:
                        parsed = yaml.safe_load(parts[1])
                        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                            seed_data = parsed
                            break
                except Exception:
                    pass

        return self._evaluate_signals(rel_files, file_snippets, seed_data)

    def _discover_custom_profiles(self) -> dict[str, Path]:
        """Discovers custom YAML profiles in target repo and configured directories."""
        profiles: dict[str, Path] = {}
        search_dirs = [
            self.target / ".metricsthinking" / "profiles",
            self.target / "config" / "profiles",
        ]
        if self.custom_profiles_dir and self.custom_profiles_dir.exists():
            search_dirs.append(self.custom_profiles_dir)

        # User global config
        user_global = Path.home() / ".gemini" / "config" / "skills" / "metrics" / "profiles"
        if user_global.exists():
            search_dirs.append(user_global)

        for d in search_dirs:
            if d.exists():
                for p in d.glob("*.yaml"):
                    stem = p.stem.lower()
                    if stem not in profiles:
                        profiles[stem] = p
                for p in d.glob("*.yml"):
                    stem = p.stem.lower()
                    if stem not in profiles:
                        profiles[stem] = p
        return profiles

    def _evaluate_signals(
        self,

    ) -> ArchetypeDetectionResult:

                    scores["web-app"].score += 45.0
                    scores["web-app"].signals.append("Dependencias frontend UI en package.json (React/Vue/Next/Vite)")
            elif "pyproject.toml" in lower or "requirements.txt" in lower:
                if any(k in content for k in ["dbt-core", "dbt-bigquery", "pyspark", "delta-spark"]):
                    scores["data-platform"].score += 35.0
                    scores["data-platform"].signals.append("Librerías de Lakehouse/dbt en dependencias")
                if any(k in content for k in ["torch", "tensorflow", "scikit-learn", "mlflow"]):
                    scores["mlops"].score += 30.0
                    scores["mlops"].signals.append("Frameworks de ML en dependencias")
                if any(k in content for k in ["langchain", "llama-index", "ragas", "anthropic", "openai"]):
                    scores["llmops"].score += 30.0
                    scores["llmops"].signals.append("SDKs de LLMs/RAG en dependencias")

        # Normalize UI points if there are many frontend files
        if scores["web-app"].score > 0 and source_code_count > 0:
            frontend_files = sum(1 for f in rel_files if f.endswith((".tsx", ".jsx", ".vue", ".svelte", ".css", ".html")))
            if frontend_files / max(1, total_files) > 0.35:
                scores["web-app"].score += 25.0
                scores["web-app"].signals.append(f"Alta densidad de componentes frontend ({frontend_files} archivos)")

        # Penalize agent-skill if the repo is predominantly a software application or library
        if scores["agent-skill"].score > 0:
            if source_code_count >= 10 and scores["software-engineering"].score > 30.0:
                # Skill is just an auxiliary accessory, not the project's core archetype
                scores["agent-skill"].score = min(scores["agent-skill"].score, 25.0)

        # Sort scores descending
        ranked = sorted(scores.values(), key=lambda s: s.score, reverse=True)
        top = ranked[0]
        second = ranked[1] if len(ranked) > 1 else None

        # Calculate confidence
        total_top_score = top.score
        if total_top_score <= 15.0:
            # Low confidence across all specialized profiles -> fallback to software-engineering or custom
            primary = "software-engineering"
            confidence = 0.50
            is_emerging = True
            rationale = "No se detectaron marcadores determinísticos dominantes de perfiles especializados; se aplica el metamodelo universal de software."
        else:
            diff = (top.score - (second.score if second else 0.0))
            confidence = min(0.95, max(0.55, (top.score / (top.score + (second.score if second else 10.0))) * 1.1))
            primary = top.archetype
            is_emerging = False
            rationale = f"Marcadores dominantes físicos confirmados: {', '.join(top.signals[:3])}."

        inspection_mode = ARCHETYPE_INSPECTION_MODES.get(primary, "source_code")
        recommended_profile = "default" if primary == "software-engineering" else primary

        runner_ups: list[tuple[str, float]] = []
        for r in ranked[1:4]:
            if r.score > 10.0:
                c_norm = min(0.90, round(r.score / (top.score + 1.0), 2))
                runner_ups.append((r.archetype, c_norm))

        is_custom = (primary not in BUILTIN_PROFILES) and (primary in custom_profiles)

        return ArchetypeDetectionResult(
            primary_archetype=primary,
            confidence=confidence,
            inspection_mode=inspection_mode,
            recommended_profile=recommended_profile,
            detected_signals=top.signals,
            runner_up_archetypes=runner_ups,
            is_custom=is_custom,
            is_emerging_domain=is_emerging,
            rationale=rationale
        )

def _with_audit_lock(function):
    from functools import wraps
    @wraps(function)
    def wrapped(target_path=".", *args, **kwargs):
        from metricsthinking.runtime import repository_lock
        target = Path(target_path).resolve()
        if not target.is_dir():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Target path '{target}' does not exist or is not a directory.")
        with repository_lock(target, "metrics"):
            return function(target_path, *args, **kwargs)
    return wrapped

    for cand in profiles_candidates:
